bibliography.title: Effect of deep eutectic solvent in proton conduction and thermal behaviour of chitosan-based membrane
bibliography.authors: a  Fuel Cell Institute, Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia, 43600 UKM Bangi, Selangor, Malaysia b  School of Engineering, Taylor's University Lakeside Campus, No. 1, Jalan Taylor's, 47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia c  Graphene & Advanced 2D Materials Research Group (GAMRG), Research Centre for Nano-materials and Energy Technology (RCNMET), School of Science and Technology, Sunway University, No. 5, Jalan Universiti, Bandar Sunway, 47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia

system_identity.dopant: choline chloride (ChCl) and urea based deep eutectic solvent (DES)

mechanism_relevant_findings: The study showed a positive improvement in proton conductivity with DES compared to those without DES.
The blend film with 75 wt% of chitosan and DES has a low but sufficient water uptake of 49.4% to avoid structural disintegration.
limitations: The study revealed a slight trade-off on thermal stability with the use of DES.

relevance_judgement.reason: The findings provide insights into proton conduction mechanisms in chitosan-based membranes.
